gloss: pearly white; pearl color; mother-of-pearl sheen

definitions.gloss: pearly white; the iridescent color of a pearl
definitions.explanation: A soft, slightly silvery white with a faint opalescent or iridescent sheen, like the surface of a real pearl. Used in writing about cosmetics, fashion, cars, and nature to describe any object with that characteristic subtle, lustrous glow.

examples.japanese: {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}のネイル。
{彼女|かのじょ}は{真珠色|しんじゅいろ}のドレスを{着|き}ていた。
examples.english: She was wearing a pearly white dress.

examples.japanese: {朝日|あさひ}が{当|あ}たる{海|うみ}の{面|おもて}が、{真珠色|しんじゅいろ}に{輝|かがや}いていた。
examples.english: The surface of the sea, struck by the morning sun, shone with a pearly glow.

examples.japanese: この{車|くるま}は{真珠色|しんじゅいろ}の{特殊|とくしゅ}{塗装|とそう}が{施|ほどこ}されており、{角度|かくど}によって{色合|いろあ}いが{微妙|びみょう}に{変化|へんか}する。
examples.english: This car has a special pearly-white paint finish, and its tone changes subtly depending on the angle.

notes:
Composed of {真珠|しんじゅ} (pearl) + {色|いろ} (color). Describes a luminous, soft white with a delicate shimmer — the kind of look aimed at in pearlescent cosmetics, car paint, and evening wear.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}の{肌|はだ}: pearly-white skin — used in cosmetics marketing
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}の{光沢|こうたく}: pearly luster / iridescent sheen
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}に{輝|かがや}く: to shine with a pearly glow
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}のネイル: pearly-white nail polish
- {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}の{塗装|とそう}: pearlescent paint finish

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {乳白色|にゅうはくしょく}: milky white — a similar soft white, but opaque rather than iridescent.
- {銀色|ぎんいろ}: silver — much brighter and more metallic; lacks the soft iridescence of {真珠色|しんじゅいろ}.
- {白|しろ}: white — the plain, unqualified word; {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} suggests a specific refined shade.
- パールホワイト: pearl white — a loanword equivalent common in cosmetics and car paint descriptions; nearly synonymous in practice.
- オフホワイト: off-white — a warm or slightly yellowish white, not necessarily iridescent.

USAGE:
You will see {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} most often in descriptive writing — novels, ad copy, and reviews — rather than in everyday conversation. In spoken language, パールホワイト or simply {白|しろ} is more common; {真珠色|しんじゅいろ} carries a slightly poetic or refined tone.
